tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Retrieve machine-readable intelligence for a Swedish company by organisation number. Returns current attribute values, resolved knowledge, signals, events, provenance, and data freshness. All values include confidence and source evidence. Unknown or missing data is returned explicitly — never invent

tools.name: get_company_history
tools.description: Retrieve the change history for a Swedish company — attribute_changed events showing when values were first observed and what changed. Optionally filter by attribute key. Returns temporal bounds (effective_from) and evidence for each event.

tools.name: find_distress_signals
tools.description: Find active warning signals for a company. Signals are deterministic rules over register facts and filed annual reports — no AI scores. Examples: vat_registration_lost, f_tax_lost, employee_band_decline, liquidation_in_progress, bankruptcy_proceeding, revenue_decline_yoy, negative_equity. Each signa

tools.name: search_company_events
tools.description: Search for company attribute change events across companies. Use this to find companies where a specific attribute recently changed, or to monitor for changes in a particular dimension (e.g. employee count drops). Returns events with company identifiers, previous/new values, and temporal bounds.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search and discover Swedish companies without knowing their organisation number. Filter by company name (partial match), industry code, or presence of active distress signals. Returns compact summary cards — each card includes the organisation_number needed to call get_company for full intelligence.

tools.name: find_related_companies
tools.description: Find companies related to the given company by evidence MIL holds: industry_cluster (same SNI classification) and address_cluster (same registered postal code). tools.name: batch_get_companies
tools.description: Resolve up to 50 companies in one call. Every requested identifier appears in the result with an explicit status (resolved, not_found or invalid_organisation_number), so absence is never signalled by omission.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Swedish companies by name or organisationsnummer (10 or 12 digits, dashes allowed). findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
